item_box_cutter.name: box cutter
item_box_cutter.description: A standard-issue box cutter, worn from use.

item_multitool.name: multitool
item_multitool.description: A compact folding multitool, still in its blister pack.

item_master_shim.name: master shim
item_master_shim.description: A stiff plastic shim, cut and filed for working a spring latch cleanly.

item_shim_card.name: makeshift shim card
item_shim_card.description: A bent scrap of laminate card stock. Not much, but it might just work.

item_energy_drink.name: energy drink
item_energy_drink.description: Chilled, sickly sweet, and the only thing on the shelf anyone actually buys at three in the morning.

item_lottery_ticket.name: scratch ticket
item_lottery_ticket.description: Scratched, and not a winner. Somebody will still give you something for it.

item_register.name: register
item_register.description: The till, open at the drawer and never quite empty.

item_tool_crib.name: tool crib
item_tool_crib.description: A shallow steel crib of the things a store needs to open its own doors: cutters, tape, spare keys, and the cards staff cut into shims.

properties._comment: One of the two sources for a lockpick, and the cheap one: a shim card lasts four attempts, which is two escapes' worth if you are lucky and one if you are not.

item_storeroom_cage.name: wire cage
item_storeroom_cage.description: A wheeled cage of high-value stock, chained to the wall and locked with something better than the door.

properties._comment: The second source for a lockpick, and the one worth the walk: a master shim lasts twenty attempts against a drawer latch or a cell door alike.
